id: 22_Replace the DC Power Supply for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机更换直流电源
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/22_Replace the DC Power Supply for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/22_Replace the DC Power Supply for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K1: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
points.K2: 残余高压，等够时间再碰
points.K10: 拆最后一颗螺丝要托住
points.K11: 装新电源，拧紧四颗螺丝
points.K13: 接线与参考图完全一致

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带脚轮的激光焊接机旁招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a blank gray wheeled handheld laser welding machine in a workshop and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光焊接机怎样更换直流电源。
overlay: 激光焊接机更换直流电源

shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：把手、侧盖、电源模块、透明罩
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a machine handle, a side cover, a power supply module and a clear plastic shield. No people.
shots.narration: 拆把手、开左盖、换电源、装回。

shots.scene: 阿杰按下开关，焊接机没有反应
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the switch but the laser welding machine does not respond.
shots.narration: 焊接机的直流电源坏了。

shots.scene: 老李提着工具箱和新电源模块走来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer comes over carrying a toolbox and a new power supply module.
shots.narration: 专业技术人员老李来更换。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先看片头的安全警示。

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 黄黑条纹的警示卡，中间是闪电和激光三角标志
shots.prompt_en: A warning card with yellow and black stripes, showing an electric shock warning sign and a laser warning sign side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 这台设备内部有高压，还有强激光。
overlay: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 触电和烧伤图标并排，下面一个惊叹号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an electric shock and a burned hand side by side with a large exclamation mark below. No people.
shots.narration: 处理不当，可能触电、烧伤。

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 阿杰拿螺丝刀伸向机箱的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student reaching toward a machine cabinet with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 非专业人员，严禁擅自拆机。

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有扳手和人形图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a wrench icon and a worker icon.
shots.narration: 这项维修只供专业技术人员。

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 老李关闭焊接机电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns off the main power switch of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 动手前，一定先断电。

shots.section_title: 残余高压，等够时间再碰
shots.scene: 电源模块图标里闪着电，旁边一个沙漏
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power supply module with a small lightning symbol inside and an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 激光电源里可能残留高压。
overlay: 残余高压，等够时间再碰

shots.section_title: 残余高压，等够时间再碰
shots.scene: 沙漏旁边一个时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass next to a clock icon with its hand sweeping round. No people.
shots.narration: 至少等5分钟，再去触碰。

shots.scene: 警示卡上一副绝缘手套图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning card with a yellow and black striped border showing an insulated glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 所有操作全程戴绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 台面上两把十字螺丝刀、一把内六角扳手和新电源
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a workbench with two cross-head screwdrivers, a hex wrench and a new metal-cased power supply module with a honeycomb vent. No people.
shots.narration: 3和5毫米十字刀、5毫米内六角、新电源。

shots.scene: 老李关机，拔下电源插头和其他线缆
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the machine, pulls out the power plug and disconnects the other cables.
shots.narration: 关机，拔掉全部线缆。

shots.scene: 老李把四个脚轮的锁扣依次踩下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake levers of all four caster wheels one by one.
shots.narration: 锁住四个脚轮，机器不会滑动。

shots.scene: 老李用内六角扳手松开把手螺丝，取下把手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer loosens the handle screws with the hex wrench and lifts the handles off.
shots.narration: 5毫米内六角松开把手8颗螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李拆下左盖顶部螺丝，取下盖板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the top screw of the left side cover and lifts the cover away.
shots.narration: 3毫米十字刀拆左盖螺丝，取下左盖。

shots.scene: 机内一块透明塑料罩盖着电源接线端子
shots.prompt_en: Inside the opened machine, a clear plastic shield covers the terminal block of a power supply module. No people.
shots.narration: 电源接线端子前，有一块透明防护罩。

shots.scene: 老李徒手取下透明罩，逐根拆下端子线
shots.prompt_en: With bare hands, the facility engineer removes the clear shield and unscrews the wire terminals one by one.
shots.narration: 取下防护罩，再拆电源左侧的接线。

shots.section_title: 拆最后一颗螺丝要托住
shots.scene: 老李一只手托住电源底部，另一只手拧最后一颗螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer supports the bottom of the power supply with one hand while removing the last screw with the other.
shots.narration: 拆最后一颗螺丝时，用手托住电源。
overlay: 拆最后一颗螺丝要托住

shots.section_title: 拆最后一颗螺丝要托住
shots.scene: 电源掉落的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power supply module falling, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防止电源掉下来。

shots.section_title: 装新电源，拧紧四颗螺丝
shots.scene: 老李把新电源放进机内，对准螺丝孔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer places the new power supply into the machine and lines it up with the screw holes.
shots.narration: 把新电源放到原来的位置。
overlay: 装新电源，拧紧四颗螺丝

shots.section_title: 装新电源，拧紧四颗螺丝
shots.scene: 老李拧紧四颗固定螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens four mounting screws on the new power supply.
shots.narration: 拧紧4颗固定螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李徒手接好端子线，把透明防护罩装回端子前方
shots.prompt_en: With bare hands, the facility engineer reconnects the terminal wires and fits the clear plastic shield back over the terminal block.
shots.narration: 接好线，装回透明防护罩。

shots.section_title: 接线与参考图完全一致
shots.scene: 平板上的空白接线示意图，旁边是机内的端子
shots.prompt_en: A simple wiring diagram on a tablet made only of lines and colored dots, next to the terminal block inside the machine.
shots.narration: 接线必须和参考图完全一致。
overlay: 接线与参考图完全一致

shots.section_title: 接线与参考图完全一致
shots.scene: 颜色和位置对应的线头图标打勾，接反的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: wires matched to terminals by color with a green check, and swapped wires with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 位置、颜色一根都不能错。

shots.scene: 盖板挂钩对准机架销钉，老李推入并拧螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer aligns three hooks on the side cover with three pegs on the frame, pushes it in and tightens the screw.
shots.narration: 三个挂钩对准三个销钉，推入左盖拧紧。

shots.scene: 老李装回两侧把手，用内六角扳手拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer refits the handles on both sides and tightens them with the hex wrench.
shots.narration: 两侧把手装回，螺丝全部拧紧。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the closed machine with step icons floating behind: a warning card, an hourglass, a power supply module and a wiring diagram.
shots.narration: 专业人员，断电，等5分钟，戴手套。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 托住电源拆螺丝，接线对照参考图。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李和阿杰在焊接机前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 直流电源换好了，下次见！
